svg.title: Guilloche enrichment: six geometry studies
svg.desc: Two contour rosettes compare regular lobes with mixed angular harmonics. A flowing wave field changes amplitude and wavelength. Two faceted lattices compare regular cells with a smooth invertible warp. An unequal three-branch leaf study explores foliate guilloche. These are original mathematical sketches, not implemented Izzi presets.
svg.text: Original construction studies · 28 September 2026 · proposals, not Izzi output

g.text: One angular mode; six equal lobes
19 nested contours; open center; exact closure
Same ring count; unequal lobes; shared radial profile
Shared grid edges, ridges and two contour levels
Every line shares the map (x + f(y), y)
Same cell topology; nonlinear spatial asymmetry
A curved stem and three differently sized branches
Intentional shared tips; junction spacing needs review

svg.text: See 20260928.meta_guilloche_survey.md for equations, source distinctions and the staged implementation plan.
